filename: Understanding Precipitation Changes through Unsupervised Machine Learning.pdf
title: Understanding Precipitation Changes through Unsupervised Machine Learning
code_availability: Training and postprocessing scripts, as well as saved model weights and Python environments, are available on GitHub at 10.5281/zenodo.7693052.
testbed_rationale: The study uses simulation output for offline unsupervised analysis and regime decomposition rather than training an online/offline climate parameterization or emulator testbed.
pain_points: Massive volume of high-resolution multi-scale 3D storm-resolving simulation data (3.4 TB for 90 days)
High spatiotemporal correlations in meteorological fields require huge sample sizes (1,000,000 test fields) for robust lat/lon localized statistical analysis
Data sparsity at extreme upper quantiles (>99.9th percentile) causing noisy/pixelated spatial fields
extraction_notes: The simulation code is openly available, and model weights/scripts are on Zenodo (10.5281/zenodo.7693052). However, full simulation output datasets are not explicitly hosted via a public URL directly in the text, only the simulation code repository is referenced.
